verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents its own native-crash pieces. It accepts events from Sentry's open-source SDKs and aims for Sentry API compatibility. Its CLI uploads native debug symbols in dSYM, PDB and ELF formats, which covers iOS and Android/NDK symbolication, and the product added minidump support. However, the evidence never names the iOS, Android or NDK SDKs as tested, and never shows how device, OS or app-version context is captured or displayed; mobile support is only inferred from Sentry compatibility. Missing for 10: explicit iOS/Android/NDK SDK documentation, evidence of device/OS/app-version context on crash events, hands-on or independent corroboration of mobile crash symbolication.
